name: Vostok Industrial Hardshell Helm
description:
A reinforced composite helmet originally designed for Crucible heavy-industry workers operating in foundry and demolition environments. The outer shell is layered carbon-ceramic rated for impact, heat, and particulate deflection. An internal gel-cushion liner auto-adjusts to head geometry.

The Vostok has migrated from industrial sites to Shelf-district security teams and unlicensed pit-fighting circuits, where its durability and low cost make it the default head protection for people who can't afford military-grade gear.
functionality: Impact protection, heat resistance, particulate filtering
what_it_says: You work where things fall, explode, or get thrown at your head. You chose function over style because you're still alive.
story_hooks: A batch of Vostok helms shipped to a Shelf clinic were found to contain embedded micro-transmitters — someone was tracking every wearer's location.
